notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Hey Guys! Thanks for waiting this long! Chapter 2 along with major updates to Chapter 1 are now live on the playtest so feel free to play them both and leave any feedback for us! Below will be a link to the Google Form where you can leave your feedback! Thanks again!

[url=https://forms.gle/11vid3sBFSrhNoQz8]Feedback Form[/url]

notes.title: Alpha Testing Form
notes.content:
Please fill out the google form listed below as soon as possible after finishing your first playthrough.  This should be an honest first impression so we can work on making it a better experience.

[url=https://forms.gle/ofQnNq9oXAcEpABB8]Playtest Google Form[/url]
